parsed.note_claim: Digital forensics link an X account (@joashamupitan) posting pro-APC content in 2023 to INEC Chairman Amupitan's personal email (amupitanj@yahoo.com) and phone from his CV
parsed.label: DOES_NOT_SUPPORT
parsed.quote: The INEC Chairman does not own or operate any personal account on X. He has at no time engaged in partisan commentary, nor has he ever associated himself with any political leaning or activity in his private or public capacity,
parsed.reason: The page reports the Chairman's denial of account ownership and labels the allegations as fabrications, failing to substantiate the note's claim of a forensic link.
